cases.result: Current subject pages are generated from the canonical inventory.

cases.result: Subject entries contain the defined matter; system entries contain the description and executable intellectual steps.

cases.operation: Retain the three-state required-condition rule while removing the surrounding source and status narration.
cases.result: A false required condition yields not achieved; an unknown required condition without a false one yields undetermined; otherwise the result is achieved.
